rationale: This CBb decision concerns the revocation of a manure derogation permit and an administrative fine for a minor exceedance of the phosphate application standard by a dairy farmer under the Dutch Meststoffenwet (Fertilizers Act). Under the protocol rules, disputes concerning agricultural manure and phosphate application standards/quotas under the Meststoffenwet are classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
